original.heading: Director’s Message
paragraphs: I believe profoundly in the strength and promise of IIT(ISM) Dhanbad. It is curiosity that fosters the growth of a community, making it unique. Curiosity and accuracy are essential for knowledge, wisdom, intelligence, and stability; therefore, let this methodical and comprehensive way of thinking serve as a guide and inspiration for our endeavours.
Together, let us embrace the future with curiosity and determination. I look forward to witnessing the remarkable contributions our community will make to society.
original.verseTranslation: ( Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached!)

pirate.heading: Life on the Isle
pirate.tagline: Where creativity pulsates… and occasionally capsizes.

cards.text: The Isle’s LightsCameraISM crew hosted Filmfest 2K26: cinema, music, dance and creativity, plus a hearty welcome for the freshest deckhands aboard. Popcorn rations were not enforced.
National Sports Day stormed Jasper Hostel’s crew quarters: 180+ deckhands battled at badminton, chess and table tennis. No cannons were fired, though the chess got close.
Manthan’s musical night ‘Alive’ rattled the rafters o’ Penman Auditorium with soulful melodies, roarin’ rock and an electrifyin’ finale. The auditorium’s resident ghosts requested an encore.

original.heading: Research
original.tagline: Fostering inventiveness, imagination, and curiosity for a lifetime.

items.title: Sensor Breakthrough
items.text: Prof. J. Nayak and his team have published a study demonstrating highly sensitive room-temperature acetic acid gas sensing using two-dimensional graphitic carbon nitride, advancing the development of efficient and selective gas sensor technologies.

items.title: Alloy Innovation
items.text: Prof. M. R. Rahul and his team have published a study demonstrating simulation-guided additive manufacturing of Fe–Ni–Nb medium entropy alloys, paving the way for predictive alloy design and controlled in-situ alloying through laser powder bed fusion.

items.title: Crustal Insights
items.text: Dr. Dhiraj Kumar Singh’s latest research unveils the crustal structure and tectonic evolution of Northeast India, offering new insights into the Shillong Massif, Dauki Fault, and Indo-Burma subduction system.

items.title: Parkinson's Insight
items.text: Prof. Niladri Patra and his team publish a study in Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling revealing key conformational mechanisms of the Parkinson’s disease-linked kinase LRRK2 through advanced computational simulations.

pirate.heading: Treasure Expeditions
pirate.tagline: Fostering inventiveness, imagination and curiosity for a lifetime. Maps not included.

items.title: A Nose for Vinegar
items.text: Prof. J. Nayak and crew have published a study on a highly sensitive sensor that sniffs out acetic acid gas (the sour stuff in vinegar) at room temperature, using paper-thin sheets o’ graphitic carbon nitride. Sharper, more selective gas sensors ahead. The galley pickles are officially under watch.

items.title: Alloys Forged by Forecast
items.text: Prof. M. R. Rahul and crew used simulations to steer the laser 3D-printin’ (powder bed fusion) o’ Fe–Ni–Nb medium-entropy alloys, mixin’ the metals right in the melt. Predict the alloy first, then forge it: the one time this ship has ever planned ahead.

items.title: A Map That Goes Down
items.text: Dr. Dhiraj Kumar Singh has charted what lies beneath Northeast India: the crust’s structure and tectonic history around the Shillong Massif, the Dauki Fault and the Indo-Burma subduction system. Finally, a treasure map that points down instead o’ sideways.

items.title: Chartin’ a Protein’s Moves
items.text: Prof. Niladri Patra and team, writing in the Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling, used advanced computer simulations to reveal how LRRK2, a kinase linked to Parkinson’s disease, changes shape. Careful navigation through very, very small waters.

items.title: Youth Awakening
items.text: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad’s centenary lecture explores Swami Vivekananda’s message of youth, purpose, discipline and responsible use of science and technology for nation-building.

items.title: Global Connections
items.text: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad’s international students, led by Prof. Rajni Singh, Dean (International Relations), interacted with the Hon’ble Governor of Jharkhand, Shri Santosh Kumar Gangwar, highlighting global learning, cultural exchange and India’s growing international academic engagement.

items.title: Groundwater Futures
items.text: INGWC-2026 brings groundwater experts, researchers and stakeholders together to address climate-linked challenges and promote scientific, sustainable and community-based water management.

items.title: Smarter Mining
items.text: KHANAN’26 brings students, academia and industry together to explore safer, smarter, sustainable and technology-driven mining practices.

items.title: Youth Awakening
items.text: A centenary lecture on the Isle explored Swami Vivekananda’s message to the young: purpose, discipline, and using science and technology responsibly to build the nation.

items.title: Global Connections, Seven-Seas Edition
items.text: The Isle’s international deckhands, led by Prof. Rajni Singh, Dean (International Relations), met the Hon’ble Governor of Jharkhand, Shri Santosh Kumar Gangwar: a voyage of global learning, cultural exchange and India’s growing academic reach across the seas.

items.title: Treasure Beneath Our Boots
items.text: INGWC-2026 gathers groundwater experts, researchers and stakeholders to tackle climate-linked challenges and champion scientific, sustainable, community-based water management. Turns out the finest buried treasure be water.

items.title: Diggin’ Smarter
items.text: KHANAN’26 brings deckhands, scholars and industry together to explore safer, smarter, sustainable, tech-driven mining. The Isle’s been diggin’ since 1926; now it digs with sensors.
